description: FREE (when enabled): try a service without paying. Either one keyword-metrics lookup for ONE keyword (send keyword), or one call of any service up to 0.05 USDC (send service and input, the same arguments as the paid tool). Returns the same JSON as the paid tool plus sample: true (no result_token). One sample per service per day per client, a shared daily total, and at most 3 failed samples per client and day; returns an error (sample_used, sample_exhausted or sample_failures) when a limit is hit. Packages such as local_market_check and services above 0.05 USDC have no sample: call list_services and check free_sample per service.

input.description: Arguments for that service, same as the paid tool.

keyword.description: Legacy keyword-metrics sample: one keyword, up to 60 characters.

language_code.description: Language code such as en or de.

service.description: Service id for a per-service sample, e.g. google-serp (see list_services, field free_sample).

name: free_sample
